name: ARTIFACT -> PROVENANCE -> HASH -> READER -> INVARIANT
question: Is this artifact the artifact the record says it is, and does an independent reader confirm the invariant the record asserts?

steps.does: git history of the artifact path: first/last commit, deletions, renames
manifest verify with coverage: COVERED / UNCOVERED_FILES / HASH_MISMATCH + manifest self-hash to anchor elsewhere
C1: receipt carries a fingerprint that matches; unfingerprinted pools FAIL, not INDETERMINATE
independent census of the artifact's rows and fields
dead-field / partial-field findings over the declared columns; NT-027 fossil inference where fossils pin a target set

output_contract: {history, manifest_verdict, manifest_self_hash_lf, receipt_c1, census, invariant_findings}; a COVERED manifest whose self-hash has no external anchor is reported COVERED_UNANCHORED
